nvitk.gui.tools.panel
=====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.tools.panel

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Magicgui Tools tab with category/operation pickers and per-tool parameters.



Attributes
----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.tools.panel._LAYER_NONE


Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.tools.panel._collect_params
   nvitk.gui.tools.panel._set_param_visibility
   nvitk.gui.tools.panel._update_reference_layers

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _collect_params(widget: Any, tool_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]

   Read the current values of *tool_id*'s parameter widgets off *widget* into a plain dict
   (layer-picker params are coerced to their layer-name string).


.. py:function:: _set_param_visibility(widget: Any, tool_id: str) -> None

   Show only the parameter widgets on *widget* that *tool_id* actually uses; hide the rest of the
   shared parameter pool.


.. py:data:: _LAYER_NONE
   :value: '(none)'


.. py:function:: _update_reference_layers(widget: Any, viewer: Any) -> None

   Refresh every reference/barrier/mask layer-picker widget on *widget* with the viewer's current
   layer names, adding a "(none)" option for the optional pickers and re-validating each widget's
   current selection against the new choice list.


.. py:function:: _prefill_vessel_cross_section_layers(widget: Any, viewer: Any) -> None

   Default CD layer dropdown from the active layer (centerline = active layer).


.. py:function:: _update_phase_layers(widget: Any, viewer: Any) -> None

   Alias for :func:`_update_reference_layers`, kept for call sites conceptually refreshing
   per-phase layer pickers.


.. py:function:: build_tool_panel(viewer: Any, app_state: dict[str, Any], *, layer_display_kwargs: Callable[Ellipsis, dict[str, Any]], on_layers_changed: Callable[[], None], record_step=None, get_label_ids=None, get_pipeline_argv_builder=None, get_totalseg_roi=None, label_selector=None) -> Any

   Return magicgui FunctionGui for the Tools tab.
